_what: The field indexes a person's record store keeps, as DATA read by src/record-engine.mjs and passed to parts/record-log. Each row names a record type, an index name and the field paths it orders by (each path a list of field names into the record; a path through a content-addressed object, such as a decision's method, follows the link). An index entry exists for a record only when every path holds a value of its own (a scalar or a list of scalars). A field read (fields.after, fields.idsWhere, fields.newestPerGroup) or a range (scan, lastPerGroup) over an index not listed here is refused by name: a new question over records is a new row here, never a scan and never code.
